Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our quality assurance team. You will be responsible for designing and implementing comprehensive automated testing solutions, building robust testing frameworks, and ensuring the reliability and performance of our applications. In this role, you will bridge the gap between development and quality assurance, utilizing strong programming skills to create scalable testing infrastructure.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and testing infrastructure
  • Create and execute automated test cases for web and API applications
  • Collaborate with development teams to understand requirements and implement comprehensive test coverage
  • Identify, document, and troubleshoot bugs and performance issues
  • Implement continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) testing pipelines
  • Build and optimize test automation for React-based applications
  • Establish and maintain testing best practices and standards
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and promote quality culture across teams
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Familiarity with performance and load testing tools
  • Knowledge of testing metrics and reporting
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies
  • Understanding of security testing and OWASP principles
  • Previous experience in a similar SDET role in a fast-paced environment
